# ISummerRewardsRedeemer
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rewards-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerRewardsRedeemer.sol)

**Title:**
ISummerRewardsRedeemer

**Author:**
Summer.fi

Interface for managing and distributing token rewards using Merkle proofs

This contract enables efficient distribution of rewards to multiple users
using Merkle trees. Each distribution is identified by an index and has its
own Merkle root. Users can claim their rewards by providing proofs of inclusion.


## Functions
### addRoot

Adds a new Merkle root for a distribution


```solidity
function addRoot(uint256 index, bytes32 root) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`index`|`uint256`|Unique identifier for the distribution|
|`root`|`bytes32`|Merkle root hash of the distribution|


### removeRoot

Removes a Merkle root


```solidity
function removeRoot(uint256 index) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`index`|`uint256`|Distribution index to remove|


### getRoot

Gets the Merkle root for a distribution


```solidity
function getRoot(uint256 index) external view returns (bytes32);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`index`|`uint256`|Distribution index to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes32`|bytes32 The Merkle root hash|


### canClaim

Checks if a user can claim from a distribution


```solidity
function canClaim(address user, uint256 index, uint256 amount, bytes32[] memory proof) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address of the user to check|
|`index`|`uint256`|Distribution index to check|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount attempting to claim|
|`proof`|`bytes32[]`|Merkle proof to verify|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|bool True if claim is possible, false otherwise|


### claim

Claims rewards for a single distribution


```solidity
function claim(address user, uint256 index, uint256 amount, bytes32[] calldata proof) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address of the user to claim for|
|`index`|`uint256`|Distribution index to claim from|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens to claim|
|`proof`|`bytes32[]`|Merkle proof verifying the claim|


### claimMultiple

Claims rewards from multiple distributions at once


```solidity
function claimMultiple(
    address user,
    uint256[] calldata indices,
    uint256[] calldata amounts,
    bytes32[][] calldata proofs
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|Address of the user to claim for|
|`indices`|`uint256[]`|Array of distribution indices to claim from|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|Array of amounts to claim from each distribution|
|`proofs`|`bytes32[][]`|Array of Merkle proofs for each claim|
